sanitization: Kept image identity, architecture, working directory and Python metadata.
Removed image filesystem storage paths, layer inventory and unrelated image configuration.
projection.hash_scope: Original input hashes identify the pre-export source bytes; they are not hashes of this rewritten projection.

controller_supplied_execution_configurat.evidence_source: Controller-reported invocation; image inspection alone does not establish these runtime flags.
controller_supplied_execution_configurat.user_selection: Invoking host user's UID:GID, overriding image default 10001:10001.

limitations: Runtime isolation parameters are supplied by the controller, not independently proven by image inspection.
The raw run records Python/platform/source identity; it is not an isolation attestation.
